tools.name: list_my_tenants_tunnelhub
tools.description: Query accessible tenants for the signed-in identity. SystemAdmin and SystemSupport receive global access from the backend. requiresSamlLogin indicates corporate login is needed before selecting a tenant.

tools.name: switch_tenant_tunnelhub
tools.description: Select a tenant for the current identity without another login when allowed by the backend. Reloads the user and environments using TenantId and resets the selected environment. Required SAML login is reported explicitly.

tools.name: login_tunnelhub
tools.description: Authenticate a shared human identity in the browser without requiring a tenant or environment. Then list and select accessible tenants; a single tenant is selected automatically unless SAML login is required.

accountName.description: Optional company hint for browser SAML login. Omit for shared login.

tenantId.description: Optional tenant hint for SAML login. Choose the working tenant after authentication.

tools.name: switch_environment_tunnelhub
tools.description: Switch the active TunnelHub environment for the current session.

tools.name: list_sessions_tunnelhub
tools.description: List saved TunnelHub sessions in local MCP storage.

tools.name: current_session_tunnelhub
tools.description: Show the current authenticated TunnelHub session.

tools.name: logout_tunnelhub
tools.description: Remove the current or a specific saved TunnelHub session.

tools.name: list_environments_tunnelhub
tools.description: List environments available to the current authenticated user.

tools.name: list_tenants_tunnelhub
tools.description: List tenants visible to the authenticated user. Intended as read-only lookup.

tools.name: get_tenant_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get read-only details for a tenant by id.

tools.name: list_users_tunnelhub
tools.description: List users from the active tenant with pagination and optional identity and role filters. Cognito pool identifiers and internal fields are omitted. Status remains visible in results but is not accepted as a filter because the backend does not match it exactly.

tools.name: get_user_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get one user by UUID from the active tenant. Cognito pool identifiers and internal fields are omitted.

userId.description: User UUID in the active tenant.

tools.name: create_user_tunnelhub
tools.description: Create a tenant membership, reusing an existing identity by normalized email or creating a new Cognito identity. The active session fixes tenantId, email is also used as the immutable username, and only tenant roles are accepted. New identities receive a Cognito invitation email. Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true because creating a membership may create a new Cognito identity and send an invitation email.

tools.name: update_user_tunnelhub
tools.description: Update only the provided profile fields for a user in the active tenant. Set changes.photoUrl=null to clear the stored profile photo URL; omitting it keeps the current value. Email and username are read-only. Profile attributes are global; environment access belongs to the selected tenant. Role, status, tenant and Cognito identifiers are not editable through this tool. Requires confirm=true.

userId.description: User UUID in the active tenant.

photoUrl.description: Profile photo URL. Use null to clear the stored URL; omit it to keep the current value.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the user profile and Cognito attribute changes.

tools.name: delete_user_tunnelhub
tools.description: Delete the user membership from the active tenant. The global Cognito identity and other memberships are preserved. Backend authorization applies. Requires confirm=true.

userId.description: User UUID in the active tenant.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm removal of this user membership from the selected tenant. The global Cognito identity and memberships in other tenants are preserved.

tools.name: list_packages_tunnelhub
tools.description: List integration packages from integrations-service using the current environment.

tools.name: get_package_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get read-only details for one package by id.

tools.name: create_package_tunnelhub
tools.description: Create an integration package. Package parameters may contain secrets; provide only values required by the integration.

tools.name: update_package_tunnelhub
tools.description: Update selected fields of an integration package. When changes.parameters is present, it replaces the complete parameter array; include every entry that must be retained and avoid exposing secret values.

tools.name: delete_package_tunnelhub
tools.description: Permanently delete an integration package. This can break systems, automations, and other resources that reference the package.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm permanent package deletion.

tools.name: list_systems_tunnelhub
tools.description: List systems from integrations-service using the current environment.

tools.name: get_system_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get read-only details for one system by id.

tools.name: create_system_tunnelhub
tools.description: Create a system in the active environment with parameters matching its type. System parameters may contain credentials or other secrets; provide only required values.

port.description: Database port. The SDK represents it as a string; numeric ports are also accepted.

password.description: Sensitive value. On update, omit it to preserve the configured secret.

custom.description: Additional system parameters as name/value pairs.

password.description: Sensitive value. On update, omit it to preserve the configured secret.

anyOf.description: SFTP connection parameters, selected by authType.

password.description: Sensitive value. On update, omit it to preserve the configured secret.

anyOf.description: CUSTOM system parameters. Use custom for name/value pairs.

parameters.description: Complete parameters matching type. Use custom for additional name/value pairs.

tools.name: update_system_tunnelhub
tools.description: Update selected fields of a system. Parameters are partial unless the system type or a parameter subtype changes; changing either requires complete parameters for the selected variant. For ordinary partial updates, omit configured secrets that should be preserved.

type.description: New system type. A type change requires complete parameters for the selected type.

port.description: Database port. The SDK represents it as a string; numeric ports are also accepted.

password.description: Sensitive value. On update, omit it to preserve the configured secret.

sshPrivateKey.description: Sensitive value. On update, omit it to preserve the configured secret.

custom.description: Additional system parameters as name/value pairs.

parameters.description: Changed parameters. Partial updates are allowed while the current type and subtype stay unchanged. Changing type, databaseType, oracleConnectionType, or authType requires the complete selected variant.

tools.name: delete_system_tunnelhub
tools.description: Permanently delete a system. This can break automations, packages, and other resources that reference the system.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm permanent system deletion.

tools.name: list_api_gateways_tunnelhub
tools.description: List API Gateway definitions from api-gateway-service using the current environment.

tools.name: get_api_gateway_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get read-only details for one API Gateway by id.

tools.name: list_api_keys_tunnelhub
tools.description: List API keys from api-gateway-service using the current environment. Sensitive values may be included by backend.

tools.name: list_usage_plans_tunnelhub
tools.description: List API Gateway usage plans from api-gateway-service using the current environment.

tools.name: list_auth_clients_tunnelhub
tools.description: List API auth clients from api-gateway-service using the current environment.

tools.name: get_auth_client_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get read-only details for one API auth client by client id.

tools.name: list_auth_resource_servers_tunnelhub
tools.description: List Cognito resource servers exposed by api-gateway-service.

tools.name: list_api_gateway_logs_tunnelhub
tools.description: List logs for one API Gateway by id.

tools.name: get_api_gateway_log_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get one API Gateway log entry and decode compressed request and response payloads when possible.

tools.name: list_all_api_gateway_logs_tunnelhub
tools.description: List API Gateway logs across the current environment for a required date range.

tools.name: list_data_stores_tunnelhub
tools.description: List conversion tables (data stores) from platform-service using the current environment.

externalCode.description: Conversion table code used in automations.

tools.name: get_data_store_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get read-only details for one conversion table by id.

tools.name: list_data_store_items_tunnelhub
tools.description: List de/para rows for one conversion table.

tools.name: get_data_store_item_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get read-only details for one de/para row by id.

tools.name: create_data_store_tunnelhub
tools.description: Create an empty conversion table (data store) in the current environment. Rows must be added separately.

tools.name: update_data_store_tunnelhub
tools.description: Update selected conversion table metadata after verifying that the table exists.

tools.name: delete_data_store_tunnelhub
tools.description: Permanently delete an empty conversion table. The operation is refused while the table has rows; delete its rows first.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm permanent conversion table deletion.

tools.name: create_data_store_item_tunnelhub
tools.description: Create one de/para row in an existing conversion table.

tools.name: update_data_store_item_tunnelhub
tools.description: Update selected values of one de/para row after verifying that it belongs to the specified conversion table.

tools.name: delete_data_store_item_tunnelhub
tools.description: Permanently delete one de/para row after verifying that it belongs to the specified conversion table.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm permanent conversion table item deletion.

tools.name: list_sql_tables_tunnelhub
tools.description: List support tables (SQL Tables) from platform-service using the current environment.

externalCode.description: Support table external code used in automations.

tools.name: get_sql_table_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get read-only details for one support table by external code.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

tools.name: list_sql_table_rows_tunnelhub
tools.description: List rows for one TunnelHub support table with pagination, filters and sorting.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

tools.name: export_sql_table_rows_tunnelhub
tools.description: Export all rows from one TunnelHub support table as CSV.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

tools.name: create_sql_table_tunnelhub
tools.description: Create a support table and its physical SQLite table in the current environment.

tools.name: update_sql_table_tunnelhub
tools.description: Update support table description or limited-user access without changing its schema.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

tools.name: migrate_sql_table_schema_tunnelhub
tools.description: Migrate a support table schema while preserving its current primary key. This can rename or remove non-key columns and permanently discard column data.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

confirm.description: Must be true because schema migration can discard column data.

tools.name: delete_sql_table_tunnelhub
tools.description: Permanently delete a support table and its data. Without force, dependencies block deletion; force also removes automation references.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

force.description: Also remove references from dependent automations.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm permanent support table deletion.

tools.name: create_sql_table_row_tunnelhub
tools.description: Insert one validated row into a support table.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

tools.name: update_sql_table_row_tunnelhub
tools.description: Update selected non-primary-key values in one support table row.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

tools.name: delete_sql_table_row_tunnelhub
tools.description: Permanently delete one support table row.

externalCode.description: Support table external code. Example: customer-cache

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm permanent support table row deletion.

tools.name: list_automations_tunnelhub
tools.description: List automations from integrations-service using the current environment. Structured results include parameters, notifications and limited-user IDs; trigger credentials are omitted.

tools.name: get_automation_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get complete automation details by id, including parameters, notifications and limited-user IDs. Trigger credentials are omitted.

tools.name: list_automation_deploys_tunnelhub
tools.description: List deploy history for a TunnelHub automation.

tools.name: get_automation_action_logs_tunnelhub
tools.description: Read action logs for a TunnelHub automation.

tools.name: create_automation_tunnelhub
tools.description: Create an active automation in the current environment. Authenticated webhook modes require complete mode-specific credentials. This creates metadata only; it does not deploy code.

tools.name: update_automation_tunnelhub
tools.description: Update only the provided automation fields after verifying that it exists. Notifications and limited-user access are intentionally unsupported here because the backend replaces those complete lists; use a dedicated operation when one becomes available. Trigger fields may be partial; omitted trigger state and its UUID are preserved by preflight. Webhook credentials may be partial while authentication stays unchanged, but changing authentication requires complete credentials for the new mode. Set trigger.notBefore to null to remove an existing schedule start restriction. Repeated updates publish backend change events.

notBefore.description: Schedule start restriction. Use null to remove the existing restriction.

tools.name: delete_automation_tunnelhub
tools.description: Permanently delete an automation. This can asynchronously remove its schedule, revisions, Lambda function, IAM role and policies.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm permanent automation and runtime resource deletion.

tools.name: execute_automation_tunnelhub
tools.description: Dispatch a TunnelHub automation manually. Its code may write to TunnelHub or external systems, so repeated calls can repeat external side effects.

tools.name: list_automation_transports_tunnelhub
tools.description: List incoming and outgoing automation transport requests visible from the active environment. Embedded automation parameters and notifications are returned; trigger credentials are omitted.

status.description: Filter transport requests by review status.

transportId.description: Filter by transport request ID. Exact matching is applied by the MCP.

tools.name: request_automation_transport_tunnelhub
tools.description: Create a pending transport request for the current published automation deployment. This validates the automation, deployment and destination but does not deploy or change the target environment.

targetEnvironment.description: Destination environment UUID. It must differ from the active environment.

requestMessage.description: Reason and context for the transport request.

tools.name: approve_automation_transport_tunnelhub
tools.description: Approve a pending request from its target environment only while the source deployment still matches the request. This creates missing package, system and conversion-table metadata, maps existing systems, transports SQL table structure without rows, creates or updates the automation, and deploys its runtime. It can leave partial target changes if a later step fails; never retry automatically after an error. force=true may recreate incompatible target SQL tables and discard their data.

reviewMessage.description: Optional approval note for the audit trail.

force.description: Overwrite transported SQL tables when the target schema differs. This can discard target data.

confirmSqlTableDataLoss.description: Must be true when force is true to confirm possible target SQL table data loss.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deployment and target-environment changes.

tools.name: reject_automation_transport_tunnelhub
tools.description: Reject a pending transport request from its target environment without deploying or changing transported resources.

reviewMessage.description: Reason for rejecting the transport request.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm rejection of the pending transport request.

tools.name: list_automation_executions_tunnelhub
tools.description: List automation executions for a required date range. startDate and endDate are mandatory.

tools.name: find_execution_tunnelhub
tools.description: Find an execution within a required date range and resolve its execution period.

tools.name: get_execution_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get execution summary details for one automation execution. Requires automationId, executionId, and executionPeriod.

executionPeriod.description: Execution period in YYYY-MM format. Example: 2026-03

tools.name: summarize_execution_tunnelhub
tools.description: Summarize one execution with details, traces, and the first 10 logs. The text prioritizes each complete jsonItem payload that fits within the response limit and may omit top-level log messages first; a trailing ellipsis after a log header marks an omitted message. The complete log page remains in structuredContent.logs.

executionPeriod.description: Execution period in YYYY-MM format. Example: 2026-03

tools.name: get_execution_traces_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get execution traces for one automation execution.

executionPeriod.description: Execution period in YYYY-MM format. Example: 2026-03

nextCursor.description: Alias for cursor. Use the nextCursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: export_execution_traces_tunnelhub
tools.description: Start an async export for the full execution trace. Use get_trace_export_tunnelhub with the returned exportId to check the status and download URL.

executionPeriod.description: Execution period in YYYY-MM format. Example: 2026-03

tools.name: get_trace_export_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get the async trace export status and download URL when it is finished.

exportId.description: Trace export id returned by export_execution_traces_tunnelhub.

tools.name: get_execution_logs_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get one page of execution logs, defaulting to current=1 and pageSize=20. The text includes pagination metadata, prioritizes every complete jsonItem payload that fits within the response limit, and may omit top-level log messages first; a trailing ellipsis after a log header marks an omitted message. The complete page remains in structuredContent.data.

executionPeriod.description: Execution period in YYYY-MM format. Example: 2026-03

lastEvaluatedKey.description: LastEvaluatedKey returned by the previous page, when present.

tools.name: get_home_statistics_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get tenant home statistics for executions and processed items in the current environment.

tools.name: get_tenant_execution_statistics_tunnelhub
tools.description: Get tenant execution consumption statistics and recharges for one month period.
